incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: streaming-tail-origin pipeline detecting elevated p99 (7m) and intermittent SSE chunk stalls. paging oncall ashita :rotating_light:
ashita: seeing p95 jump to 450ms and p99 ~2.7s on the live-proxy pool. Customers on EU region complaining about blank responses during streams. paging triage in this thread.
leo: working on a quick blast radius check — are only long-tail clients affected or widespread?
maria: I can confirm 4 customer sessions reported stalls in last 10m, region eu-west-1. Backend model latency looks normal.
jonah: proxy write queue depth increasing, some 502s from edge->proxy timeouts. suspect slow consumer backpressure.
nashita: thumbs up. can someone grab proxy pod logs and streaming gateway metrics?
leo: running: ```bash
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/stream-proxy -c proxy --since=15m | grep -E "write_timeout|slow_consumer|socket_write" || true
```
leo: output shows repeated "socket_write_timeout" at ~6883728950 and a few `client paused` messages.
ingrid: capturing p95/p99 traces from trace service: ```json
{"route":"/v1/stream","p95":450,"p99":2700,"count_last_5m":1243}
```
ashita: good — that matches. Are we seeing any recent deploys to the proxy or gateway?
maria: no deploys in last 2 hours. autoscaler did scale some proxy replicas up at 6883728700.
jonah: noting increased TCP retransmits on the node facing those clients. Could be network blips causing client-side buffering.
leo: also seeing a small uptick in continuous batching queue time on the serving runtime (~30ms -> 120ms) but not enough to explain p99.
incident-bot: created incident INC-2026-331, severity: P2. Paging slo-watch and eng-sre.
ashita: mitigation options: 1) enable conservative keepalive/proxy backpressure throttle; 2) temporary pool routing away from problematic edge nodes; 3) enable small write-chunking fallback to reduce large writes. Thoughts?
maria: immediate: flip proxy throttle to drop slow-consumer connections after extended write timeouts (config: `proxy.consumer_timeout_ms=12000`). This should free pipeline backpressure.
jonah: I'm on it — rolling config to 3 replicas now. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/stream-proxy PROXY_CONSUMER_TIMEOUT_MS=12000 -n prod`
leo: adding a short-lived rule to route new sessions to healthy AZs only: `route: region=eu-west-1 az!=eu-west-1b` to see if it isolates.
nashita: while that runs, spin up an obs query for customer impact: `sum by(customer_id) (increase(stream.errors[10m]))` and `topk(10, increase(stream.duration{status="stall"}[10m]))`
ingrid: query results: 3 customers have >80 stall events in last 10m (cust_132, cust_47, cust_909). We should reach out.
maria: sending outreach note to CSMs with list + mitigation steps.
jonah: config roll applied to 3/3 proxies. Logs showing fewer socket_write_timeout entries in last 60s.
leo: routing rule applied — traffic shifted away from eu-west-1b. Early metrics: p99 down from 2.7s -> 1.3s in 90s. p95 now ~380ms.
nashita: good improvement. Keep monitoring for 15 minutes. Can we also capture a heap of one proxy and core dump if needed?
jonah: grabbing thread dump now: ```bash
kubectl exec -n prod -it deploy/stream-proxy -- /bin/sh -c 'pmap $(pidof proxy) > /tmp/proxy_map && tar -czf /tmp/proxy_debug.tgz /tmp/proxy_map /var/log/proxy.log'
```
incident-bot: note added: page->eng-oncall (ashita), severity:P2, started 6883729000.
ashita: beginning handoff prep. If we hold steady, we'll transition to sre-next in 20m for watch. Action items before handoff: 1) confirm client outreach done, 2) ensure routing rule stays until next check, 3) attach logs and query snapshots to incident.
maria: outreach sent to CSMs for cust_132 and cust_47 with temporary workaround (reconnect recommended).
leo: I saved query snapshots: https://monitoring.internal/graph?incident=INC-2026-331 (link)
jonah: updating incident with commands executed and logs tarball location: s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-331/proxy_debug.tgz
ingrid: observed one edge node with elevated NIC drops — net team notified (paginated).
nashita: okay team — current status: mitigations applied, measurable improvement in p99/p95, customer outreach started. We'll do handoff to sre-next for 2hr watch. If anything regresses, page ashita immediately.
sre-next: thanks, taking over watch. I'll keep the routing rule and proxy throttle for now. Leaving reminder: investigate root cause — possible client TCP flaps vs subtle proxy IO starvation.
ashita: ownership assigned: follow-ups -> jonah (logs + deeper proxy profiling), leo (az routing analysis + metric dashboards), ingrid (net team liaison), maria (customer comms).
jonah: noted. I'll dig into kernel-level socket stats and collect `ss -tin` samples.
ashita: handoff complete at 6883729045. :white_check_mark:
sre-next: acknowledged — monitoring on.
incident-bot: incident INC-2026-331 status: watching, assignee: sre-next, next update expected in 30m.
